name: Tasty Snail 21
author: KareemTolan
description: Neon pill sky-blue toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, starts the shake animation (sliding). Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #ccc to #2196f3, box-shadow becomes 0 0 10px #fff, 0 0 20px #fff, 0 0 30px #2196f3, 0 0 40px #2196f3, 0 0 50px #2196f3, 0 0 60px #2196f3, 0 0 70px #2196f3, transform becomes translateX(26px). On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 2px #2196f3, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 3px #2196f3.
